statement: Exploratory evaluation of the frozen Study 3 policies against the existing generated-environment framework. The completed held-out block at root 32,000,000 was Part A only: ten scripted monotone families with currents pinned at zero and acoustic noise a deterministic function of the acoustic ramp. It therefore produced no adaptation-coverage measurement. This block runs stochastic generated environments instead, on a fresh seed band, and reports numbers only.
question_answered_beyond_heldout: Whether the frozen selector behaves comparably in stochastic, non-monotone environments where modalities fail and recover at random times, rather than along fixed ramps.
What adaptation coverage is outside the twelve V5 development seeds at root 31,900,000, which are the sole basis of the 59.8% standing limitation.
How the selector behaves when currents and acoustic noise vary as independent processes, which no registered scripted family exercises.
band: 33-million exploratory. Disjoint from Study 2 (20.x M), platform_v2 (22.1-22.3 M), Study 3 development (31.x M) and Study 3 held-out (32,000,000, spent).
seed_registry_note: STUDY3_SEED_REGISTRY.json is hash-pinned in STUDY3_FREEZE_MANIFEST_V1.json and is deliberately NOT modified. This record is the registration of the exploratory band.
environment_seed_list_rule: root + 1000 + n for n in range(60), i.e. 33001000..33001059, matching the V5 Part B convention.
pairing: One environment realization is generated per seed and shared identically by all three policies, so contrasts are paired on the environment.

environment_config.name: moderate_severe_variable_multimodal
environment_config.note: Byte-identical to the file used by V5 Part B and hash-pinned in the freeze manifest.

execution_parameters.provenance: inherited unchanged from run_final_validation_v5.py Part B

adaptation_primary.name: V5 C7/C8 definition
adaptation_primary.definition: Episodes are maximal runs of constant truth_side_best_viable_mode beginning after the first sample, lasting at least 6 s. An episode is matched if the selected navigation_mode equals that best viable mode at any sample within it; latency is the time to the first such sample.
adaptation_primary.reason_reported: It is the definition that produced the 59.8% figure, so this is the only directly comparable number.

adaptation_secondary.name: corrected pilot adequate/exact definition
adaptation_secondary.definition: Episodes are runs of a constant physically acceptable mode SET persisting at least 3 samples. Adequate = the selected mode is in the acceptable set AND is observably supported. Exact = the acceptable set is a singleton and the selected mode equals it AND is observably supported.
adaptation_secondary.replay_rule: Observability is not stored in a packet, so REACTIVE runs are deterministically replayed in-process with a recording policy subclass. Each replay must reproduce the packet's trace_digest exactly; a mismatch aborts the analysis. The replay introduces no new evidence and consumes no seed.

contrasts.interval: 95% paired bootstrap, 10,000 draws, single stratum (one generated family)
contrasts.note: The analysis RNG affects resampling only and no simulation.

prohibitions: No frozen file is modified; the freeze manifest is verified before execution.
The held-out root 32,000,000 is refused by the runner.
Results are reported regardless of direction and may not be used to revise the held-out result or STUDY3_FREEZE_DECISION_V1.md.
The scripted-transition block (Part E2) is not run.
